title: Prepare before you start
details: Keep details ready so the form can be finished in one sitting (about 15-30 minutes). The process is free, online and paperless; no documents are uploaded.
inputs_needed: Aadhaar of owner/authorised signatory (mobile linked for OTP); PAN; GSTIN if applicable; bank account number and IFSC; NIC code of activity; number of employees; investment in plant & machinery/equipment; turnover

title: Open the official portal
details: Go only to udyamregistration.gov.in. Choose the option that fits you: New Registration (not yet registered), Migrate from Udyog Aadhaar/UAM, Assisted UAM migration, or Udyam Assist Platform (informal micro-enterprises).

title: Validate Aadhaar
details: Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar number and name of the owner. Proprietorship: proprietor's Aadhaar. Company/LLP/partnership/HUF: Aadhaar of the authorised signatory, partner or karta. Verify with the OTP sent to the Aadhaar-linked mobile.
inputs_needed: Aadhaar number; Aadhaar-linked mobile for OTP

title: Validate PAN
details: Select the type of organisation (proprietorship, partnership, LLP, company, HUF, etc.) and enter PAN. The system checks it with the tax database and picks up PAN/GST-linked details automatically. PAN and GSTIN (as applicable) are required for Udyam since 01-04-2021.
inputs_needed: Organisation type; PAN; GSTIN if applicable

title: Enter enterprise details
details: Fill enterprise name, address of office and plant/unit, contact details, status and date of commencement, bank IFSC and account number, main activity (manufacturing / services / both), NIC code(s) and number of persons employed.
inputs_needed: Enterprise name; addresses; email and mobile; bank details; NIC code; employee count

title: Enter investment and turnover
details: Give investment in plant & machinery/equipment and turnover. These decide whether you are Micro, Small or Medium. GST/Income-tax linked data is picked up automatically where available.

title: Declare and submit
details: Tick the self-declaration and click Submit and Get Final OTP. Enter the last OTP received on the Aadhaar-linked mobile to complete the registration.

title: Receive Udyam Registration Number and certificate
details: A permanent Udyam Registration Number (URN) and an e-certificate (Udyam Registration Certificate, with QR code) are issued and sent by email. Download later via Print/Verify > Print Udyam Certificate using the URN. No renewal is needed.

title: After registration
details: Keep the certificate for bank loans, schemes and tenders. Update details when they change. MSME sellers can onboard a TReDS platform (InvoiceMart, M1xchange, RXIL, DTX India) for invoice discounting. Use Udyam for CGTMSE-backed loans and the micro-enterprise credit card once live.

title: Aadhaar
details: Of the proprietor, authorised signatory, partner or karta; mobile must be linked for OTP

title: PAN
details: Of the enterprise/proprietor; validated against tax database

title: GSTIN
details: Required where applicable under the GST Act (notified by Ministry of MSME, effective 01-04-2021)

title: Bank details
details: Account number and IFSC

title: NIC code
details: Activity classification of the enterprise (from portal dropdown)

title: Employees, investment, turnover
details: Self-declared; PAN/GST-linked data is auto-picked where available

title: Cost
details: Registration is free of cost. No fee is payable to anyone. Use only the government portal; beware of fake paid sites.

title: No documents to upload
details: Registration is paperless and based on self-declaration; no proof or certificate needs to be uploaded.

title: One registration per enterprise
details: An enterprise cannot file more than one Udyam Registration, but any number of activities (manufacturing, service or both) can be added to one registration.

title: Old registrations
details: Enterprises with EM-II, UAM (Udyog Aadhaar) or other older MSME registrations must re-register on Udyam.

title: Classification from 01-04-2025
details: Micro: investment up to Rs 2.5 crore and turnover up to Rs 10 crore. Small: up to Rs 25 crore and Rs 100 crore. Medium: up to Rs 125 crore and Rs 500 crore. Both limits must be met. (S.O. 1364(E), 21-Mar-2025.) Some websites still show older limits.

title: Informal micro-enterprises
details: Informal micro-enterprises without GST/PAN can register through the Udyam Assist Platform (UAP).

title: Validity
details: Registration is permanent; no renewal. Certificate carries a QR code for verification.

title: Approx. time
details: About 15-30 minutes if all details are ready.

title: Do I need a CA or agent to register?
details: No. It is a self-service, free process; you only need Aadhaar, PAN (and GSTIN if applicable) and basic business details.

title: Can a street vendor or home business register?
details: Yes, if it meets MSME limits. Informal micro-enterprises can use the Udyam Assist Platform.

title: Is Udyam needed for PMMY/Mudra?
details: Not mandatory for PMMY, but Udyam helps with CGTMSE-backed loans, the micro-enterprise credit card and other schemes.

title: Where do I download my certificate later?
details: On the Udyam portal: Print/Verify > Print Udyam Certificate, using the Udyam Registration Number.
